title: Flatness of tame local normalization
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, $G$ a finite group with order invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor. Let $U\subset S$ contain $\eta$, let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and let $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its generic restriction, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ be such that every $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Put $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $l:L\to C$, and let $N\to C$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Assume $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is a discrete valuation ring and that $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. Then $n$ is flat at every point of its source. No section or rational point is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the standard tame-chart theorem to the local normalization. Its affine etale charts are jointly surjective and have finite products of monic AdjoinRoot algebras as their coordinate rings.
Each monic AdjoinRoot factor is free, hence flat; finite products are free by the finite Pi basis instance. The displayed chart morphism is therefore flat.

Transport the flat standard algebra morphism across each chart isomorphism using its equality over Spec R_i. The jointly surjective etale family is fppf and hence fpqc; apply fpqc flatness descent to the resulting flat second projections.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_trait_flat {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    IsFinite n → Flat n
